Recorded status: In Progress.

Evidence-supported working state: Old recorded evidence. The 4 August 2026 note records samples received and a pending colour decision.

Gap: That note does not establish current progress as of 4 November 2026. It also does not prove no further work has happened. No staleness rule was supplied.

Minimum check: Confirm whether the colour decision remains pending and obtain dated evidence of the latest position. Any status update requires human review.
